scenes.heading: Understanding different real estate investment strategies

sents.d: Understanding different real estate investment strategies
Different strategies suit different capital levels, risk tolerance, and time commitments.
Buy-and-hold rental investing focuses on long-term appreciation and ongoing rental income, while house flipping focuses on shorter-term profit from buying, improving, and reselling a property.

Wholesaling (contracting to buy a property, then assigning that contract to another buyer for a fee, without ever owning the property) requires less capital upfront but relies heavily on deal-finding skill and a network of buyers.

Each strategy has a different risk profile, capital requirement, and time commitment — choosing based on your actual available capital and time, not just which seems most profitable in theory, leads to more sustainable results.

take: Pick an investing strategy that fits your capital and time.
